h1: Custom Ceramic Putty for Branded Giveaways
metaDescription: Order custom ceramic putty for your next promo event. Soft, non-stick stress putty with your logo. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Ceramic putty offers a unique tactile experience that standard foam or rubber stress relievers can't match. The smooth, non-stick texture makes it ideal for desk fidgeting without leaving residue on hands or keyboards. Marketing directors often choose custom ceramic putty for trade show swag because it stands out from the usual pens and koozies. Decorate with a simple screen-printed logo or embossed design for a subtle brand presence that recipients actually keep at their workspace.
heroAltText: Custom ceramic putty in a round tin with a company logo printed on the lid, displayed on a desk
